title: Decoding FIELD_VALUES rows via resource.DecodeSearchValues
answers: How do I read field values out of a ResourceSearchResponse in FIELD_VALUES mode?
Where is the generic decoder for field-value search rows?
body: resource.DecodeSearchValues(result.Fields, row) converts a ResourceSearchRow into a map keyed by field name (as declared in result.Fields), handling per-type value arrays. Consumers index into this map by field-name constants (e.g. builders.TEAM_SEARCH_EMAIL, builders.TEAM_SEARCH_PROVISIONED, resource.SEARCH_FIELD_TITLE) to populate response structs — see pkg/services/team/search/search.go:parseFieldValueResults for the pattern to follow when adding a new FIELD_VALUES-based response parser.
applies: Any new search handler consuming ResourceSearchRequest_FIELD_VALUES responses
says: How do I read field values from a search response?

How to populate my response from FIELD_VALUES search data?
How do I extract named fields from search results?

search: Decoding FIELD_VALUES rows: use resource.DecodeSearchValues(result.Fields, row) to convert ResourceSearchRow into a map keyed by field-name constants (builders.TEAM_SEARCH_EMAIL, builders.TEAM_SEARCH_PROVISIONED, resource.SEARCH_FIELD_TITLE). This mechanism handles per-type value arrays and allows indexing into the result map to populate response structs. The pattern is demonstrated in pkg/services/team/search/search.go:parseFieldValueResults. Applies to any new search handler consuming ResourceSearchRequest_FIELD_VALUES responses.
